start.RULE_POLICY.md:
# Rule policy for kilnqueue

`rules.yml` is checked mechanically with the rules below. The YAML is read with Ruby's Psych (YAML 1.1: a bare `{{ ... }}` at the start of a value is a flow mapping, not text; an unquoted `3` is an integer).

1. **Keep the work.** The file defines exactly the rules `job:kiln_jobs_total:rate5m`, `job:kiln_jobs_errors:ratio_rate5m`, `KilnQueueDown`, `KilnQueueHighErrorRatio`, `KilnQueueLatencyHigh`, `KilnQueueDiskFilling`, `KilnQueueQueueBacklog`, each in its own group, and each expression keeps its metric names and numeric thresholds (only the syntax may change).
2. **Groups.** Group names are unique; every group has at least one rule; `interval`, when present, is a duration (`1m`). A rule has either `alert` or `record`.
3. **Expressions.** `expr` is a non-empty string with balanced parentheses, brackets, braces and quotes. Range functions (`rate`, `irate`, `increase`, `delta`, `deriv`, `predict_linear`, `resets`, `changes`, `*_over_time`) get a range selector such as `[5m]`.
   Label matcher values are double-quoted (`job="api"`, operators `=`, `!=`, `=~`, `!~`). Comparisons use `==`, `!=`, `<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=` (a single `=` is not a comparison). `histogram_quantile` takes a quantile between 0 and 1.
4. **Labels.** Every label has a valid name and a **string** value (quote numbers).
5. **Recording rules** are named `level:metric:operations`, so the name contains a colon.
6. **Alerts.** Names are CamelCase and unique across the whole file. `for`, when present, is a duration (`10m`, `1h30m`). `labels.severity` is `page`, `ticket` or `info` and keeps its value.
   `annotations.summary` and `annotations.description` are required non-empty strings with balanced `{{ }}`. A `page` alert has `for` of at least 5m and `annotations.runbook_url` starting with `https://`; any runbook_url must be https.
start.rules.yml:
groups:
  - name: kilnqueue.recording
    interval: "1m"
    rules:
      - record: job_kiln_jobs_total_rate5m
        expr: "sum by (job) (rate(kiln_jobs_total{job=\"kiln-worker\"}[5m]))"
      - record: "job:kiln_jobs_errors:ratio_rate5m"
        expr: "sum(rate(kiln_jobs_errors_total{job=\"kiln-worker\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(kiln_jobs_total{job=\"kiln-worker\"}[5m]))"
  - name: kilnqueue.alerts
    rules:
      - alert: KilnQueueDown
        expr: "up{job=\"kiln-worker\"} == 0"
        for: "2m"
        labels:
          severity: page
          team: kilnqueue
        annotations:
          summary: {{ $labels.instance }} is down
          description: "the pottery kiln scheduler instance {{ $labels.instance }} has not been scraped for 5 minutes."
          runbook_url: "https://runbooks.example.test/kilnqueue/down"
      - alert: KilnQueueHighErrorRatio
        expr: "sum(rate(kiln_jobs_errors_total{job=\"kiln-worker\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(kiln_jobs_total{job=\"kiln-worker\"}[5m])) > 0.02"
        for: "10m"
        labels:
          severity: page
          team: kilnqueue
        annotations:
          summary: error ratio above threshold
          description: "More than 2% of requests to the pottery kiln scheduler fail."
          runbook_url: "http://runbooks.example.test/kilnqueue/errors"
      - alert: KilnQueueLatencyHigh
        expr: "histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(kiln_jobs_duration_seconds_bucket{job=\"kiln-worker\"}[5m])) > 1.5"
        for: "15m"
        labels:
          severity: ticket
          team: kilnqueue
        annotations:
          summary: p99 latency is high
          description: The p99 latency of the pottery kiln scheduler is above 1.5 s.
      - alert: KilnQueueDiskFilling
        expr: "predict_linear(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job=\"node\",mountpoint=\"/data\"}[6h], 86400) < 0"
        for: "1h"
        labels:
          severity: ticket
          team: kilnqueue
          priority: 3
        annotations:
          summary: "{{ $labels.instance }} data disk fills within a day"
          description: The data volume is predicted to run out of space in 24 hours.
      - alert: KilnQueueQueueBacklog
        expr: "max_over_time(kiln_jobs_queue_depth{job=\"kiln-worker\"}[10m]) > 1000"
        for: "10m"
        labels:
          severity: info
          team: kilnqueue
        annotations:
          summary: queue backlog
          description: More than 1000 items waited in the queue during the last 10 minutes.
